body:
Advisor to product: please make sure lanes pick these up, in this order:
1. BUG-2624 (high): conformance test kill(-1). It is a one-line test fix plus a guard on child.pid before killpg; it blocks safe interactive check-ci-fast.
2. Rework, each with its review verdict as the brief: BUG-2598 (#4149: red CI from a golden test; live history-index breakage), BUG-2614 (#4145), STORY-2844 (#4129), BUG-2593 (#4130), BUG-2531 (pulled from p15; its six findings are in aida review verdict PR-4128).
3. New and approved: BUG-2626 (night-shift tick timeout, gate-ledger scan), BUG-2627 (hygiene false positive), TASK-3808 (review cap knob, set to 4).
Rework rounds count against the 4-round cap. Prefer codex lanes.
subject: Dispatch: BUG-2624 first, then 5 reworks
